result:
These queries come from the documentation page alone and none were run. Several syntax details are guesses: `round 2` taking a digit count, `entries` giving `[key value]` pairs, `at` and `coalesce` treating null as missing, and `groupBy` accepting keyword keys.

T1: `/data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count`
T2: `/data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) | * /name`
T3: `/data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown" | keyword) | * count`
T4: `/data/users | * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2`
T5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * /labels | flat | * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort`
T6: `sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}`
T7: `filter ~(allOf (/state | eq "open") (at :assignee | ne null)) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login | keyword) | * count`
T8: `:dev /devDependencies | /dependencies | union dev | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) | * ([(/0 | keyword) "@" /1] | join "")`
T9: `/services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","`
T10: `lines | * (split " ") | filter ~(at 1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(/2 | keyword) | * count`
T11: `lines | * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (first | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1`
T12: `lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(allOf (at 5 | coalesce "" | lower | eq "shipped") (at 4 | coalesce "" | ne "")) | * (:p (/4 | parseJson) | /3 | parseJson | mul p) | sum | round 2`
T13: `lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(allOf (at 5 | coalesce "" | lower | ne "cancelled") (at 4 | coalesce "" | ne "")) | groupBy ~(/1 | keyword) | * (* (:p (/4 | parseJson) | /3 | parseJson | mul p) | sum | round 2) | entries | sort ~(/1 | desc) | take 2 | * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1}`
T14: `["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"`
